name: Creative Eye Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Creative Eye Ltd is engaged in the production of Audio-Visual T. V. Content.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
CEL started its journey making Television content for Doordarshan. It has produced many well-known and award-winning serials featuring many popular stars. Its forte lies in making mega mythological serials. The company is in the business of the production of TV content/ Licensing of TV serial rights.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.76 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -32.1% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -5.72% over last 3 years.
